name: pi-local-llama-plus
description: Personal fork of pi-llama-cpp 0.14.0 for the local llama-server on 127.0.0.1:9931. The saved default model stays restorable even when the server is busy, loading, or temporarily down: the health probe accepts ik_llama busy state, the last known model list is cached and registered while the server is unreachable, and a background retry refreshes it. Provider id is unchanged (llama-server=<url>) so existing settings keep working.
author: sbsamarski (fork of pi-llama-cpp by Gabriel Sanhueza)
